title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00119 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 00:15: Continued to install BPV plug for drop protection and xmas tree lifting cap. Meanwhile worked to perform BOP test no5
00:15 - 02:30: Remove scaffolding from around xmas tree and r/d electric and hydraulic lines from xmas tree. Meanwhile performed pre-job meeting to n/d xmas tree, pressure tested BOP test no5
02:30 - 03:15: Removed hatches and beam between slots. Meanwhile worked to pressure test BOP test no6, 7
03:15 - 04:00: Removed master bushing and outer ring. Lowered diverter chains on TDS bails to wellhead and attached to x-tree. Meanwhile pressure tested BOP test no7
04:00 - 04:15: Performed pre-job meeting to lift xmas tree
04:15 - 05:15: Took weight as per lifting plan and removed grayloc clamp. Lifted x-tree to moonpool. Transfered load to gantry crane in moonpool. Attached lifting arrangement from TDS to spacer spool
05:15 - 06:30: Released NT-2 connector on wellhead, had difficulties to release 2x tight bolts. Meanwhile prepared HP riser on rig floor
06:30 - 08:15: Cut control lines, installed communication collar and dart on BPV, cleaned up seal area. Meanwhile p/u riser from HTS
08:15 - 08:45: Installed covers in moonpool using rigfloor winch
08:45 - 09:15: P/u and RIH HP riser and m/u NT-2 connector
09:15 - 11:00: Removed scaffolding from test stump and built scaffolding around HP riser. Performed checks prior to skid BOP to well center. Meanwhile worked to m/u TDS test assembly
11:00 - 11:15: Performed pre-job meeting to move BOP to well center
11:15 - 12:00: Skidded BOP to well center and landed off on HP riser. Meanwhile pressure tested kelly hose to 20/345 bar, 5/10 min
12:00 - 12:15: Performed pre-job meeting to m/u NT-2 connector
12:15 - 13:30: M/u NT-2 connector. Meanwhile pressure tested upper/lower ibops and 2x fosvs to 20/345 bar, 5/10 min
13:30 - 13:45: Performed pre-job meeting to connect tension cylinders
13:45 - 15:00: R/u tension system
15:00 - 15:15: Performed pre-job meeting to handle slick joint
15:15

Released NT-2 connector on wellhead, had difficulties to release 2x tight bolts. Meanwhile prepared HP riser on rig floor

R/u tension system
Performed pre-job meeting to handle slick joint
Removed master bushing, RIH with slick joint and m/u same, measured RKB to top of annular 5. 78m
Performed pre-job meeting to handle diverter

P/u and RIH w/ diverter and landed off. Continued m/u slick joint. Meanwhile removed chains from bails and connected overshot hose. Energized overshot, lined up and filled hole with 3m3. No leaks observed
Lined up cement unit through kill HCR, closed bsrs. Applied 20 bar to kill HCR valve to confirm line up
With slick joint made up, fine tuned tension cylinders for equal pull
Performed connection test to 20/345 bar 5/10 min, good test
Finished to m/u slick joints, cleaned and cleared rig floor
Changed handling equipment to 3. 5in DP
Performed pre-job meeting to retrieve dart and BPV
Retrieved dart from BPV
Retrieved BPV
R/b 3. 5in DP, l/d retrieval tool
Changed handling gear, prepared for running THRT
Performed pre-job meeting to r/u casing tong

Performed pre-job meeting to run w/ THRT and landing string
P/u and RIH with tubing hanger running tool
